_readme: Source of truth for the Cloudflare WAF custom rules and the rate-limiting rule of Timekeeper Work. Replace api.example.mn / admin.example.mn with the real hostnames and the inline IP list with your own. Apply with infra/cloudflare/apply.sh. Fits the Free plan (5 custom rules, 1 rate-limiting rule: check the current limits on Cloudflare's plan page); more rules need a paid plan. Roll out in 'log' mode first (see docs/security/waf-hostinger-cloudflare.md).

customRules.description: Block attack probes, scanner tools and impossible methods
customRules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.git") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.aws") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/xmlrpc") or (http.request.uri.path contains "phpmyadmin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/cgi-bin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/actuator") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/server-status") or (http.request.uri.path contains "../") or (http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e") or (http.request.uri.path contains "%00") or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php")) or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".asp")) or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".aspx")) or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jsp")) or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "sqlmap") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "nikto") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "nmap") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "masscan") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "acunetix") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "wpscan") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "gobuster") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "dirbuster") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "nuclei") or (http.user_agent eq "") or (not http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "PUT" "PATCH" "DELETE" "OPTIONS" "HEAD"})

customRules.description: EMERGENCY (off by default): API host only for Mongolia and trusted IPs
customRules.expression: (http.host eq "api.example.mn") and (not ip.src.country in {"MN"}) and (not ip.src in {198.51.100.10 198.51.100.11})

customRules.description: EMERGENCY (off by default): challenge every browser on the admin host

rateLimitRules.description: Per-IP limit on the sign-in endpoints
